name: promoter
description: Auto-role for members advertising the server in their custom status or with its native server tag.

configFields.label: Promoter Role
configFields.description: Role granted to members advertising the server

configFields.label: Match Terms
configFields.description: Phrases to look for in custom status text, case-insensitive

configFields.label: Detect Server Tag
configFields.description: Grant the role when the member wears this server's native tag

configFields.label: Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for grant and revoke event cards. Leave blank to disable.

configFields.label: Sweep Interval
configFields.description: Minutes between self-heal sweeps that catch missed server-tag changes

endUserDataStatement: Stores each member's promoter role grant timestamp and signal reason, plus guild-wide grant and revoke counters, to manage the role. Custom status text is processed live and never stored.
